note: Registry names are the old ui/block file names; each block item is the block published on the page whose slug is the item's description and whose install command names the item (page fetched and the item name found on it: cards-demo-1 -> /blocks/cards/background-overlay-card, features-section-demo-3 -> /blocks/feature-sections/bento-grid, bento-grid-example-three -> /blocks/bento-grids/three-column-bento-grid, background-dots-masked-vertical -> /blocks/backgrounds/background-with-dots-masked-vertical, text-animation-*-demo -> /blocks/text-animations/<same name minus -demo>, footer-with-grid -> /blocks/footers/huge-footer-with-grid, three-columns-with-images -> /blocks/bento-grids/three-column-with-images). ui items map to the page that installs them (lamp -> /components/lamp-effect shows @aceternity/lamp, glowing-stars -> glowing-stars-effect, 3d-card -> 3d-card-effect) or uses their file (globe -> /components/github-globe uses components/ui/globe.tsx); grid -> /components/grid-and-dot-backgrounds (page title names the component; weaker evidence). 27 of 30 expected to fill; moving-line, input and label have no page (no /components/<name>, and the moving-border/lamp pages do not install them) and stay url-less.
